globals.name: input-file
globals.description: Path to file containing JSON document input

operations.name: query
operations.description: Run SQL and return columns and rows as JSON (open mode: runs any statement the database accepts; identical to exec)

params.name: statement
params.description: SQL to run (any SQL; multiple statements run in order and the last one's rows are returned)

params.name: db
params.description: Path of a SQLite database file, or a postgres:// DSN (prefer connection: argv is visible to other users). With a settings file, allowed only if it sets allow_direct

params.name: connection
params.description: Name of a configured connection: from the settings file if there is one (which also sets its permission level), else the environment variable LMSQL_<NAME> holding a SQLite path or a postgres:// DSN

params.name: maxRows
params.description: Inline threshold (1..10000, default 200): a result with more rows is written in full to a file (spilled: true) instead of inline; in a file response, the preview size (default 20)

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Inline threshold in serialized bytes (1..16777216): a bigger result is written in full to a file instead of inline

params.name: out
params.description: Write the full result to this file (streamed; replaced atomically; parent directories created) and return a summary with a preview

params.name: outFormat
params.description: Format of the out file: ndjson (one JSON object per row), csv (RFC 4180, header row) or json (one array); default from the out extension, else ndjson

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Abort the statement after this many milliseconds (1..300000), also the lock wait
